function.name: flypost_parse_and_publish
function.description: Parse a natural-language event description into a structured Flypost event and store it.

naturalLanguageInput.description: Raw event description, e.g. 'Open house Sunday 1-4pm at 2212 Ocean Park Blvd, Santa Monica...'

userContext.description: Optional metadata about the caller or channel.

function.name: flypost_events_near
function.description: Retrieve events near a latitude/longitude within a search radius.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Defaults to Santa Monica if omitted.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Defaults to Santa Monica if omitted.
